toff.cut_in.2.text: After me, I think you'll find. Breeding.

toff.cut_in.3.text: Mind out, there's a good chap. Peerage coming through.

toff.apology.1.asr: Frightfully sorry, Tower. Won't happen again. It will.

toff.apology.2.text: Sincerest apologies. Put it on Daddy's account.
toff.apology.2.asr: Sincerest Apologies, put it on Daddy's account.

toff.insult.1.text: You fly like a startled pheasant, old boy.
toff.insult.1.asr: You fly like a startled pheasant, old boy.

toff.insult.2.text: Was that a landing or a cry for help?

toff.retort.2.text: I'd be offended if I knew who you were.
toff.retort.2.asr: I'd be offended if I knew who you were.
